# Fix: Explore-to-Scout Enforcement Pipeline is Completely Dead

## Context

Every session in plan mode launches "Explore" agents instead of "scout" agents, despite having:
- A rule (`use-scout-not-explore.md`) explicitly banning Explore
- A hook (`explore-to-scout.mjs`) designed to intercept and deny
- Code checks in `agent-validate.mjs`, `no-haiku-enforcer.mjs`, `navigator-validate.mjs`, `task-router.mjs`

**None of these fire.** The entire agent validation pipeline is dead.
